name: sparklens-vscode
description: Analyze Apache Spark physical execution plans directly in VS Code.

sparklens.pythonPath.description: Optional Python executable used to launch the SparkLens bridge. When empty, the extension uses the workspace's local .venv when present, then falls back to python.

sparklens.projectPath.description: Optional absolute path to the SparkLens repository root or installed source checkout. When empty, the extension auto-discovers the backend root from the extension directory or the active workspace.

sparklens.enableAI.description: Enable the existing Gemini explanation pipeline. This may make network requests and requires GEMINI_API_KEY.

sparklens.analysisTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time allowed for one analysis, in seconds.
